title: Settings scroll fade — same size, stronger effect

steps.path: How quickly content disappears under the title
steps.hint: Scroll inside each drawer to reveal the fade, then outside it to reach the next version. Switch between Meadow Mist, Halftone and a solid theme above.
steps.headline: Does a stronger fade work without making it any bigger?
steps.risk: Review-only Settings comparison. Every version stays 42px deep with the same 10% side taper and the same provisional 20% title line. Only how quickly row content disappears within the fade changes. No production styling has changed; other scroll surfaces need their own check.

variants.label: Previous 42px
variants.summary: The version you just saw. Content fades steadily across the 42px edge.

variants.label: A bit stronger
variants.summary: Same size. More of the content disappears near the edge, without adding a coloured strip.

variants.label: Much stronger
variants.summary: Same size. Content disappears quickly near the edge, which might feel abrupt while scrolling.
